order: 본 실험 판단 구조 셈 발주문 v1 (11/18 밤 확정, 판단 보강 세션 → 실험 에이전트)
device: CPU only, nice -n 19, container <= 32 GB, wait when host memory use > 80 %

inputs.JC: PH/main_judgecheck_v2/PHD-MAIN-JUDGECHECK-v2 (read only): analysis/gt_<prior>.npz (GT points), analysis/patches_<prior>.npz (majority_counts), geometry_raw patch_id, sight free5/free10, stage0/tau.json, figures_cache/ortho_campus.npz, docs fig1_judgment_map_<prior>.json (scenes)
inputs.JP: PH/main_judgeprobe_v1/PHD-MAIN-JUDGEPROBE-v1 (read only): patch_<prior>.npz (JC patch values in JC gid order, incl. case, mixed, building, place)
inputs.JABL: PH/main_judgeabl_v1/PHD-MAIN-JUDGEABL-v1 (read only): variants/<region>__<prior>.npz (식별 1 판정), addendum2/patch_case_<prior>.npz (patch case pc, tot, share); docs tables s_main_summary, s_all_variants, addendum2/p_patch_unit
inputs.code: JUDGEABL a1_variants.load (patch arrays), JC jc2_judge.target_height, JP plane_distance, JP p7_figs (oblique_view, draw_on_view, mvs_near) imported, not modified

definitions.cases: JC 0 두 자료 모두 유효, 1 사전정보 오류, 2 영상 깊이 오류, 4 영상 깊이 결측; always in this order
definitions.valid: finite prior height and finite patch normal (JUDGEABL)
definitions.significant: 차이가 유의한 패치 = valid and n >= 4 and base geometry code 1 (outside base L; = base '한계 밖')
definitions.no_limit: 한계가 없는 패치 = valid and n >= 4 and base L not finite (u_M or sigma_P etc. missing); counted on its own; patches of this set without a finite MVS mean height cannot take 영상 깊이 사용 and keep the base judgment in every variant (count recorded)
definitions.missing: valid and 0 <= n < 4 (base sight rule: 결측 or 제거)
definitions.patch_state: JUDGEABL addendum 2 patch case: majority of all GT point cases in the patch (majority_counts over the five JC cases), a tie containing case 0 -> 0, other ties -> 동률 (excluded), fewer than 3 GT points -> excluded (count written), no GT point -> 참값 없음; 3 = 네 경우 밖
definitions.place: patch place (JP patch place: 0 면 안쪽, 1 면 경계, 2 건물 가장자리)
definitions.region: patch search region (SW R1 R2 R3E R4 R5 B0 none)
definitions.point_count_view: GT points (paired) in the patches, by the point's own case (four cases + 네 경우 밖 = other paired cases)

section_3_1.shares: area share of patch states (0, 1, 2, 4, 네 경우 밖) over significant patches with a state; also area of 동률, <3 points, no GT; and GT point share by point case
splits: surface (LoD2 지붕, 벽, 모두; ALS 지붕)
section_3_1.by_building: per building (patch building), significant area >= 5 m2; area share of each state over the building's significant area with a state; 10, 50, 90 % quantiles (unweighted over buildings), building count
section_3_1.reach: for GT points of case 2 (and case 1, likewise all four cases): share by the point's patch set: significant / inside (일치) / no_limit / n < 4 / other (invalid, n >= 4 without finite MVS height and not inside or outside, no patch)
section_3_1.jp_check: roof significant patches with JP case 1 vs 2, excluding JP mixed (majority share < 0.8) = JUDGEPROBE-v1 report sample counts; and the same with the addendum 2 patch state, mixed included

section_3_2_lower.name: 구조 하한
section_3_2_lower.rule: start from the base judgment; significant -> 영상 깊이 사용 (2); inside stays 일치 (precision-weighted mean target), missing stays the base sight result (결측 / 제거), everything else the base judgment

no_limit.나: 영상 깊이 사용 where a finite MVS mean height exists, else base

section_3_2_lower.target: JC target_height with base u_M, sigma_P, sigma_W
section_3_2_lower.compare: same-judgment share with JUDGEABL '식별 1 없음·영상 깊이 사용' (variants npz), area and patch count; if 100 % its values are reused and that is written

section_3_3_upper.upper: 구조 상한 (참값으로): 구조 하한 (가) with image-error patches -> 사전정보 사용 (1, target = prior height)
section_3_3_upper.upper2: 구조 상한 2 (참값으로): 구조 하한 (가) with significant patches where, over the patch's GT points of the four cases (>= 3 points), share of points within tau of the image-depth target (MVS mean height) < 0.5 and share within tau of the prior target (prior height) >= 0.5 -> 사전정보 사용; the >= 0.5 rule is the addendum 2 patch target rule
section_3_3_upper.stored_rows: rows other than the structure rows come from JUDGEABL s_all_variants (point) and addendum2 p_patch_unit (patch), not recomputed
section_3_3_upper.summary: a = mean of four case target-ok %, b = minimum and its case, c = max over cases of (best target-ok % among the JUDGEABL non-GT pool + 구조 하한 (가), (나)) - this row; JUDGEABL pool = not 패치 다수결 상한, not 기존 4 세 실험 지역, not 참값으로 고름, not reference, not family fix, not family old4 in scope 전체
section_3_3_upper.name_ok: region == expected judgment of the case (0 일치, 1 영상 깊이 사용, 2 사전정보 사용, 4 결측)
section_3_3_upper.building_diff: building x case cells with >= 200 GT points (surface pooled as the row's surface): median of (row - 본 방법) %p (JUDGEABL a2 rule)

scoring.point: JUDGECHECK-v2 2.5: GT point takes its patch judgment and target; ok = |plane distance along the GT normal to (patch centre + h normal)| <= tau (JP plane_distance); distance recomputed only for patches whose target height differs from the stored base target (JUDGEABL a1 rule)
scoring.patch: addendum 2: patch ok = at least half of the GT points whose case equals the patch state are within tau; area-weighted over patches with that state; total = patches with one of the four states

section_3_4_grid.detector: expected value, no sampling: image-error patches switch to 사전정보 사용 with probability R, other significant patches (all significant patches not in state 2, including states 0, 1, 4, 네 경우 밖, 동률, < 3 points, no GT) with probability F
section_3_4_grid.per_patch: point view: per case, number of GT points within tau under 영상 깊이 사용 (MVS mean height) and under 사전정보 사용 (prior height); patch view: patch ok under each
section_3_4_grid.precision: R A_E / (R A_E + F A_O), A_E = image-error patch area, A_O = other significant patch area (all); second column with A_O restricted to patches with a state (0, 1, 4, 네 경우 밖)
section_3_4_grid.boundary: per F, smallest R where the row exceeds 본 방법 (strict >), three criteria: (1) total target-ok, (2) mean of four cases, (3) prior-error and image-error case both >= 본 방법; reported as the grid R and as the exact R from the linear expectation (values are linear in R for fixed F); none if not reached at R = 1
section_3_4_grid.splits: prior x surface (LoD2 지붕, 벽, 모두; ALS 지붕)
section_3_4_grid.limitation: real detectors miss non-randomly; this is an estimate of required performance

figures.fig11: per prior: three experiment sites + the six JUDGECHECK-v2 figure 1 buildings (scenes and extents from its json); roof patches only drawn (walls are not visible from above, as JC figure 1); significant patches coloured by patch state; ortho background JC figures_cache; caption = state area shares of the scene (roof + wall)
figures.fig13_maps: same scenes, three columns 본 방법 / 구조 하한 / 구조 상한: roof GT points (not walls) coloured target ok / wrong
figures.fig13_examples: six image-error patches, largest connected groups first (image-error significant patches connected within 0.36 m per building, group area descending, one per building); per panel: oblique training image crop (JP p7 oblique_view rule) with the patch, section ±0.15 m slab ±1.5 m: GT points, prior plane, MVS points, patch boundaries; text d, L, s_P, s_M, base judgment
figures.fig12: bars of the 3.3 rows per case (point view), and patch view in a second row
figures.fig14: per prior (LoD2 모두, ALS 지붕): x = F, y = R, colour = total target-ok minus 본 방법 (point view), three boundary lines

checks: base values = JUDGEABL s_main_summary (all cells) and s_all_variants (per surface)
per significant surface: state counts + < 3 points + tie (+ no GT) = significant patch count
grid R = 0, F = 0 equals 구조 하한; R = 1, F = 0 equals 구조 상한 (point and patch views)
구조 하한 vs 식별 1: patches with different judgment, count and reason
